# Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone) (`magic-items:stone-of-good-luck-luckstone`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.
